_readme: Maps app sound events to audio files in this folder. To use your own sound: drop the audio file into src/assets/audio/ and change the 'file' value of an event below. 'label' and 'description' are shown in Settings > Sounds. 'defaultVolume' (0-100) is only the initial value for new users; the live value is stored in user settings. See README.md in this folder.

click.label: Mouse click
click.description: Plays on every mouse click across the app.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.description: Plays when switching tabs (clock, statistics, settings).

focusStart.label: Focus start
focusStart.description: Plays when a focus session starts.

focusComplete.label: Focus complete
focusComplete.description: Plays when a focus session is completed.

breakComplete.label: Break complete
breakComplete.description: Plays when a break is over.
